pool: WBM unique_prototype == True with every required column
taxonomy: harness.round2.family2 — confidence.family() with fluoride/sulfide/nitride/carbide inserted after oxide; halide_topup uses the frozen confidence.family()
fluoride: not drawn: a strict subset of confidence.family()'s halide, analysed as a halide subfamily on the combined round-1 + top-up halide calibration set
method: drawn only from ids neither the original split nor the round-1 family split ever used; groups drawn SEQUENTIALLY against a shared taken-set (they overlap chemically), each per-bin proportional to that group's own share of what is still available; pandas.DataFrame.sample(random_state=seed + group index + bin index)
leakage_guards: every original and round-1 calibration and locked-test id excluded by id
every candidate sharing a reduced formula with any locked-test id dropped
groups drawn sequentially, so no id is in two draws or in both a calibration draw and a locked half
each group drawn and certified on its own chemistry only

halide_topup.no_test_half_reason: round 1 already locked 2,000 halide test ids; that half still serves halide, so the top-up is calibration only

nitride.no_test_half_reason: only 0 candidates left after the calibration draw (< 500); this group's thresholds are calibration-set results with no held-out half

carbide.no_test_half_reason: only 0 candidates left after the calibration draw (< 500); this group's thresholds are calibration-set results with no held-out half
